No local carrier
No carrier sync
vs DSB-SC: no carrier-recovery circuit needed
Chain: mic → AM mod → PA → channel → RF amp → envelope det. → DC block → audio amp → speaker
Envelope detection needs no local carrier — that is why AM receivers stay simple and cheap.
Trade-off: AM wastes about two thirds of transmitter power on the carrier (max efficiency 33%).
